note: Underdog Bonus Table (Playtest v1.10, p. 136). A 1 brings no bonus: On Your Own...

bonuses.name: Whispers and Spies
bonuses.text:
You hear rumours of your enemy's location and move to encircle them.

You can re-roll reinforcement rolls for friendly fighters this battle.

bonuses.name: A Poison Package
bonuses.text:
Vials of poison are delivered to your warband from an unknown sender.

You receive d3 Vials of Poison that you can immediately equip to friendly fighters (any you do not equip are placed in your stash).

bonuses.name: A Tincture of Choice
bonuses.text:
A powerful benefactor arranges an alchemist to brew a potion to aid you in the battle to come.

Pick 1 of the following items and either equip it to a friendly fighter or place it in your stash: Tonic of Speed, Tonic of Strength, Tonic of Steady Aim, Tonic of Fortitude, Tonic of Mind, Tonic of Levitation.

bonuses.name: Silver Bounty
bonuses.text:
An enemy of your enemy contacts you on the eve of battle. They will pay good silver to see the other warband defeated and driven away.

In step 5 of the Aftermath Sequence, your warband earns d6 silver for each enemy fighter taken down during the battle. For each enemy fighter killed in the Aftermath sequence, your warband earns an additional 25 silver.

bonuses.name: The Hidden Holding
bonuses.text:
You learn of a holding in this area of the City, if you can drive away your rivals it is yours for the taking.

Make a d66 roll and keep it hidden from your opponent. The result is another Holding, its location known only to you. If you win this battle and pick 'Seize the Prize' you can take control of this holding instead of the prize holding.
